text:
maria.g: Hey everyone — just got my company MBP and the macOS setup assistant is stuck on "Waiting for device enrollment". Tried rebooting, still there. Any IT folks around to check FleetDM assignment?

it-support: Hi Maria — sorry about that. Can you paste the serial number (or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | awk '/Serial/ {print $4}'`) and tell us if you're on home wifi or a corp network?

maria.g: Serial: C02ZQ0ABCDEF. I'm on home wifi behind a Google Nest. Rebooted twice. Also when I skip enrollment and finish setup, System Settings shows FileVault asking to create a recovery key but then fails with "Unable to create recovery key".

sam.k: @it-support FYI we had a small FleetDM backend retry earlier today, might be related.

devops-bot: [fleetdm] Incident 1234: enrollment-assignments in us-west are retrying (automated remediation running).

it-support: Thanks — that lines up. Two quick things to try: 1) Connect to a wired or hotspot network (Nest sometimes blocks MDM traffic). 2) If you can, join the OKTA VPN (use the Okta Verify prompt) — that routes to internal FleetDM endpoints. If that doesn't work, we can push a manual enroll link.

maria.g: Trying hotspot from my phone now. Also can I get a temp admin so I can install Homebrew + Rosetta if enrollment needs a workaround?

it-support: We can grant a 4-hour temp-admin. Filing the request now. Please confirm when you want the window.

rachel.p: Welcome Maria! Ping here once you have admin and we can get you on the #welcome-1:1 list. :wave:

maria.g: Hotspot + reboot done. Enrollment still stuck. Would the manual link help?

it-support: Yes — run the enroll command we use for edge cases: `curl -fsS https://fleet.internal.company/enroll.sh | sudo bash` (this will contact FleetDM and register the device). If it succeeds you should see "Enrollment complete" in the terminal and then FileVault recovery key will be generated automatically. If it errors, paste the output here.

maria.g: Running now... got "Enrollment complete (device id d_12345)". System Settings changed to show managed by company. FileVault prompt now says recovery key created.

it-support: Great — thanks for the quick test. Temp-admin window starts now for 4 hours (install whatever you need). Leaving a note to revoke at expiry.

sam.k: Awesome, welcome aboard @maria.g :tada: If you need any dev tooling tips, DM me.

maria.g: Thanks everyone — all set. Will reach out if anything else pops up.
